claims.claim: The new sensor architecture enables more frequent heart rate sampling and a readiness score, while also supporting truly continuous heart rate monitoring on both the Series 12 and Ultra 4.
claims.bestSource: The Apple Watch Series 12 is the start of a new wearable era
claims.evidence: Most notably, the redesigned sensors mean the Series 12 and Ultra 4 are now capable of truly continuous heart rate monitoring. Together, these hardware upgrades enable a host of new software features, including more frequent heart rate sampling, a new readiness score, and a brave new world of Audio Intelligence, which is what Apple is calling its upcoming suite of AI-powered ambient listening features.
claims.bestPassage: Most notably, the redesigned sensors mean the Series 12 and Ultra 4 are now capable of truly continuous heart rate monitoring.

claims.claim: Apple published a white paper that compares this continuous monitoring against a gold‑standard Polar H10 chest strap and against competitors such as the Pixel Watch 4, Samsung Galaxy Watch 8, Oura Ring 5, and Whoop across various workouts and at rest.
claims.bestSource: The Apple Watch Series 12 is the start of a new wearable era
claims.evidence: Apple put out a white paper comparing how accurate its continuous heart rate monitoring is to a gold-standard Polar H10 chest strap, as well as competitors like the Pixel Watch 4, Samsung Galaxy Watch 8, Oura Ring 5, and Whoop across several types of workouts and at rest. (It’s an interesting read for wearable nerds!) I’d need roughly eight arms and legs to replicate this study in a week, and alas, I’m not an octopus.

claims.claim: Audio Intelligence raises privacy questions, and the reviewer acknowledged that last year’s models remain solid choices with fewer privacy issues and are often available on sale.

claims.evidence: I’d understand if you have qualms about Audio Intelligence and privacy, and to those folks: I’ll remind you that last year’s models are still great, probably available on sale, and don’t come with as many privacy questions.

claims.claim: For users weighing an upgrade, Apple has laid a strong foundation for ambitious future features, even though several of the most interesting health and AI tools are scheduled to launch later this year.
claims.bestSource: The Apple Watch Series 12 is the start of a new wearable era
claims.evidence: Several of the most interesting health and AI features aren’t launching until later this year and weren’t available for review. For those pondering upgrades, Apple has laid a strong foundation with its hardware for some ambitious features down the road.

editorial.claim: The current hardware closes the gap between Apple and niche rivals like Whoop and Oura, but the full impact of the new ecosystem will depend on the rollout of pending software features and how users respond to privacy safeguards.
